title: Inside the spectrometer (model only)
summary: Placeholder illustrative model-only content for identifying the internal optics; this is not an SOP.

steps.title: Remove the cover in the 3D model
steps.body: Remove the cover in the 3D model to reveal the illustrative optical bench. Keep the real instrument closed.
steps.caution: On the real instrument, cover removal is authorized-service-only because of the Class 3B/4 laser beam and CCD light exposure hazards. This model view is not authorization to open the instrument.

steps.title: Identify the optics, grating, and beam path
steps.body: Identify the illustrative optics and grating that separates the collected light, then follow the depicted beam path. The internal routing is schematic and is not a manufacturer-verified optical layout or an instruction to touch optics or adjust mounts.

steps.title: Replace the cover in the 3D model
steps.body: Replace the model cover to finish the illustrative walkthrough. The real spectrometer cover stays installed throughout.
